errors.evidence: The purple line ('Mindestlohn') shows several distinct upward steps between 2015 and 2022, rising from an index of 100 to about 115. Describing this as a 'geringfügig' (minor/slight) increase is an over-generalization that overlooks the stepped nature of the increases.
